notes.text: The sheet is a wholly cancelled typescript numbered 19. It covers 2.1.1 through 2.2.3 and ends mid-sentence at on note. The archive number reads 26 in the original image orientation. No date or total page count is stated.
notes.basis: Observed page numbers, headings, bottom continuation, and source cancellation strokes; crop 13 checks only the archive number.

notes.text: The page describes a biextension on a G_(P times Q)-torsor through two partially defined composition laws, then writes scalar-compatibility and interchange formulas. The abandoned scalar formula is retained through its unfinished phi(.
notes.basis: Transcription of opening paragraph, abandoned display, (2.1.1.1), and (2.1.1.2); this is a content description, not a proof check.

notes.text: The page names unit sections e_E/P and e_E/Q, states canonical trivializations on 1_P times Q and P times 1_Q, and states their agreement over 1_P times 1_Q. It calls the resulting section a section unité or section neutre and begins an argument for the announced equality.
notes.basis: Observed 2.2 paragraph and displays (2.2.1)–(2.2.3); the source indexing is retained, with no mathematical repair.

notes.text: Distinct overprints occur in ces/ses, Groupe/groupe, and Ces/ces. Both component letters are represented and chronology is left open. Heavy same-letter striking in the first E of 2.2 is kept distinct from the separately cancelled t.
notes.basis: Local ink observations in crops 05, 07, 09, and 10.

notes.text: All twelve mechanical C marks have explicit outcomes: four resolved and eight retained. Two earlier unmarked C questions, the cancelled a and the unfinished formula ending, are also explicitly settled. The old revision-layer question is addressed by the E/t and two tail entries.
notes.basis: C-mark coverage and c_doubts entries, checked against the actual ink.

notes.text: No mathematical checking was performed. Mathematics was used only to notice which glyphs, indices and punctuation required local inspection. The page’s cancellation is not interpreted as a refutation.
notes.basis: Run scope; check_events is intentionally empty.

notes.text: The full-page drawing retains six main cancellation paths, with the left oval placed beside the opening-law line. The paired local curves at (2.1.1.2) are independently drawn. Ordinary insertion calls are represented by their correct attachments. The source has no closed rectangular frame.
notes.basis: Whole and both half views; crop 06 for the small paired curves. Page-spanning paths are normalized to the complete text block so the prose can reflow.
